items.mainDefect: isTeamAdminOrOwner combines isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with &&, so only owners pass and team admins are wrongly refused with FORBIDDEN.

secondary.defect: When booking.eventType.teamId is null, the team admin/owner queries still run against teamId 0 instead of being skipped.

items.mainDefect: sendAddGuestsEmails gets the raw guests input instead of uniqueGuests, so an existing attendee in the request gets a duplicate scheduled email.

secondary.defect: The catch around sendAddGuestsEmails swallows the error without logging it.

items.mainDefect: The blacklist check compares guest emails without lowercasing them, so a blacklisted address written in different case gets past it.

secondary.defect: The duplicate check against existing attendees is case-sensitive, so the same person can be added twice with different casing.

items.mainDefect: The blacklist check compares guest emails without lowercasing them, so a blacklisted address written in different case gets past it.

secondary.defect: The exact-match check against existing attendees lets duplicates in through case differences.

items.mainDefect: The blacklist check compares guest emails without lowercasing them, so a blacklisted address written in different case gets past it.

secondary.defect: The existing-attendee check is also case-sensitive, so duplicates get through with different casing.

items.mainDefect: The guests array has no maximum size, so one request can add thousands of attendees and turn the endpoint into an email-spam relay.

secondary.defect: Seat limits and seatsShowAttendees are not enforced on seated events, so capacity can be exceeded and attendee emails exposed.
Guests can be added to cancelled or past bookings because booking status is not checked.

items.mainDefect: isInvalidEmail is never reset on success, on email edits, or on close through onOpenChange, so the error banner stays visible.

secondary.defect: Closing the dialog through onOpenChange does not clear multiEmailValue, so stale emails remain.
The onError message is a template string that is always truthy, so the unable_to_add_guests fallback never runs.

items.mainDefect: Guest uniqueness is only enforced on the client; the server does not normalize case or dedupe guests against each other or against existing attendees.

secondary.defect: Concurrent requests can insert duplicate attendees because the read and insert are not in a transaction and there is no unique constraint.
sendAddGuestsEmails is passed the raw guests list instead of the deduplicated uniqueGuests.
